summary: AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory provides free shared OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible model APIs. At verification time, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and MiniCPM5-1B were free and online; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp was limited-free and experimental; MiniCPM-V46 was listed but temporarily offline. AMD says displayed points represent relative usage, not a charge, but does not publish account quotas or reset rules.
claim_steps: Open the AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory at developer.amd.com.cn/radeon/tokenfactory.
Sign in with an AMDAI account and obtain an API key.
Use the OpenAI-compatible base URL https://developer.amd.com.cn/radeon/api/v1 with a currently online model ID.
Check the live Token Factory before relying on a model because the catalog is beta and availability is dynamic.

social_proof.title: AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory
social_proof.text: Public Free Model APIs — Ready-to-use free API endpoints. The portal labels Token Factory as BETA and requires sign-in to obtain an API key.

social_proof.title: AMD Token Factory public model directory
social_proof.text: The live official directory returned five public model cards: DeepSeek V4 Flash text and vision, Qwen3.8 Flash Next, MiniCPM-V46, and MiniCPM5-1B.
